wood: One girl go bush with im friend dem for gather firewood.
tree: E climb tree, e slip, and im hand stuck inside the wood.
left: Im friend dem jealous because e sabi find wood well. Dem leave am there and deny say dem see am.
song: Alone for bush, the girl de sing any time wey e hear sound.
hunter: One hunter hear im song. Later e carry the song go village, where im family recognise im voice.
rescue: Village people carry tool dem go bush and free the girl from the tree.
wound: But the hand wey stuck get serious wound.
promise: Im mama promise say anybody wey heal im pikin fit marry am.
animals: Monkey, Panther, Lion and other animal dem try, but none fit heal the wound.
hare: For last, dem allow Hare for try. E use medicine from the land around dem.
healed: Hare succeed, and the girl recover.
suitors: When man dem come for marry am, e refuse even the rich and important one dem.
choice: E choose Hare, wey help am when the other one dem no fit.
gratitude: E remember im kindness and keep the promise wey im mama make.
lesson: The lesson na for value help, loyalty and truth pass money or position.
end: Na this be the story of the girl wey choose Hare.
